answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the sparrow log shows the live set and the dawn audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 731 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 221 aliases alive thus means 221 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the cedar quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
